title: No one failed. The process failed.
subtitle: Why Unstructured Group Trip Planning Breaks Down
quote: When individual constraints remain hidden and everyone negotiates simultaneously without structure, compromise leaves everyone unsatisfied.

stats.label: Trip Drop-off
stats.detail: Group trips initiated in chat apps that stall and are eventually abandoned without booking.

stats.label: Resentment Spike
stats.detail: Participants reporting silent resentment over asymmetric planning burden and unvoiced budget limits.

stats.label: Debate Drag
stats.detail: Average time spent going back-and-forth on destinations before planning momentum drops to zero.

takeaways: Asymmetric information: people hide budget & date limitations to avoid friction or social awkwardness.
Lack of sequential hierarchy: debating destinations before knowing budget guarantees circular arguments.
The 'Organizer' penalty: single individuals take the emotional and logistical burden, leading to burnout.
